title: Internal Hom base change through a filtered finite-free coefficient colimit
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe [def-weil-size-convention], with a sheaf of commutative rings $R$. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], relative derived tensor computed using K-flat complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-pc-kflat-complex], derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $H_R=R\mathcal Hom_R$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Assume filtered colimits of $R$-module sheaves are exact. Let $I$ be a small filtered category and $(S_i)_{i\in I}$ a diagram of sheaves of commutative $R$-algebras, with each $S_i$ isomorphic as an $R$-module sheaf to $R^{d_i}$ for a finite nonnegative integer $d_i$. Let $S=\varinjlim_i S_i$ be its sheaf-algebra colimit, whose underlying module is the filtered sheaf-module colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $K\in D(R)$ satisfy the following continuity property: for every diagram $(M_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$ of cochain complexes of $R$-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with a common termwise lower bound, the evaluation-induced map
$$\varinjlim_i H_R(K,M_i^\bullet)\longrightarrow H_R(K,\varinjlim_i M_i^\bullet)$$
is an isomorphism, with filtered colimits computed by exact termwise sheaf colimits of functorial representatives. For every $L\in D(R)$ with bounded-below cohomology, the canonical evaluation-transpose comparison
$$S\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}H_R(K,L)\longrightarrow H_S(S\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}K,S\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}L)$$
is an isomorphism in $D(S)$. It is natural in $K,L$ and in compatible morphisms of the algebra diagrams. Its restriction to $D(R)$, under the evaluation-normalized scalar-adjunction identification, is the composite
$$\begin{aligned}
S\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}H_R(K,L)&\simeq\varinjlim_i(S_i\otimes_R H_R(K,L))\\
&\simeq\varinjlim_i H_R(K,S_i\otimes_R L)\\
&\simeq H_R(K,S\otimes_R L).
\end{aligned}$$
In this formula a bounded-below representative of $L$ is used, and the stage comparisons are the evaluation-defined ones. They are compatible with every transition map of the diagram, independently of choices of finite bases. No constructibility of $L$ or finite Tor amplitude of $K$ is assumed.

proof.text: Use the existing strict representative models and unique normalized comparison. The finite-free-stage comparison and denominator are quasi-isomorphisms. Filtered continuity supplies the colimit denominator, post map and tensor-colimit isomorphism. Exact filtered colimits of the stage comparisons, their strict cocone square, and two-out-of-three prove filteredColimit_comparison.

Use the normalized strict scalar-chain identification. The object and morphism formulas identify its extension functor with E. Its sigma formula and uniqueness prove scalarComparison_existsUnique; its sigma_natural proves scalarComparison_naturality. The standard single-complex tensor isomorphism gives nu from total degree-zero tensor to restricted termwise extension. Its pure-tensor and theta evaluation formulas give scalarComparison_restriction. Evaluate the square on s tensor f and then x. Compose the two normalization equalities with naturality of the R-resolution unit; both sides are the same double-resolution image of s tensor f(x). Tensor generators and actual Hom projections detect equality.

Each finite-free module gives an exact tensor functor by the finite-free-stage calculation. Tensor preserves coefficient-sized colimits, and exact filtered colimits imply exactness of tensor by colim T.modules. Transport along T.colimitIso and the degree-zero component of nu to obtain exactness of E followed by restriction. Ordinary scalar restriction is exact and conservative and therefore reflects finite limits, so E is exact. The ordinary adjunction makes restriction preserve K-injectives.

Transport filteredColimit_comparison along T.colimitIso. In scalarComparison_restriction, gamma is a quasi-isomorphism since nu is invertible and restriction is exact. Derived Hom of gamma is a quasi-isomorphism. The extra Hom augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism because its two targets are K-injective: restriction preserves the S-resolution, and the R-resolution is K-injective. Thus the strict square and two-out-of-three make the restricted scalarComparison a quasi-isomorphism. Exact conservative restriction reflects it. Exact E preserves eta_R(L), and homFixed preserves quasi-isomorphisms, giving the denominator.

The previously constructed evaluation-normalized scalarComparison and its invertible denominator define the actual derivedComparison roof. Localization inverts both quasi-isomorphisms, hence the roof is invertible. The existing pure-tensor uniqueness proofs give strict naturality in both complex inputs and the coefficient-module diagram; localization preserves these identities. No additional bound on the functorial resolutions or on Hom is imposed.

Exact tensor and ordinary scalar adjunction prove the quasi-isomorphism assertion on these representatives without the separate derived flat-evaluation roof or ind-finite-free derived scalar model.

lean.statement: theorem derivedInternalHom_filteredColimit_comparison (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v r}) {I : Type (max u v r)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] [HasFilteredColimitsOfSize.{max u v r, max u v r} (Modules.{u, v, r} J R)] [AB5OfSize.{max u v r, max u v r} (Modules.{u, v, r} J R)] (S : I ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v r}) (algebra : (Functor.const I).obj R ⟶ S) [HasColimit S] (φ : R ⟶ colimit S) (hφ : ∀ i : I, algebra.app i ≫ colimit.ι S i = φ) (T : ModuleDiagram.{u, v, r} J S algebra φ) (hfree : ∀ i : I, ∃ d : ℕ, Nonempty (T.modules.obj i ≅ limit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin d ↦ SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v r} RingCat.{max u v r})).obj R))))) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules.{u, v, r} J (colimit S))] (E : Modules.{u, v, r} J R ⥤ Modules.{u, v, r} J (colimit S)) (h : ∀ M : Modules.{u, v, r} J R, E.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings φ M) (hmap : ∀ {M N : Modules.{u, v, r} J R} (f : M ⟶ N), E.map f = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom φ M f ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm) [E.Additive] (P L : CochainComplex (Modules.{u, v, r} J R) ℤ) (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P) (hcont : Continuous.{u, v, r} J R (I := I) P) (b : ℤ) (hL : ∀ n : ℤ, n < b → IsZero (L.X n)) : ∃ hd : QuasiIso ((homFixed.{u, v, r} J (colimit S) ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)).map ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map ((resolutionUnit.{u, v, r} J R).app L))), @IsIso _ _ _ _ (@derivedComparison.{u, v, r, w} C _ J _ _ R (colimit S) _ φ E h hmap _ P L hd)
lean.note: Universal representative formulation: P is any K-flat representative of K, L any strictly bounded-below representative of the second derived input, and E the ordinary scalar-extension functor with its specified objects and maps. Exact finite-free-colimit scalar extension computes its derived functor on these representatives. The actual map in D(S) is derivedComparison, fixed by pure-tensor evaluation and the actual localization factorization. Auxiliary declarations give its strict termwise-colimit formula, scalar-adjunction normalization and naturality. No mathematical hypothesis or clause of the node is changed. R6: the unchanged strict representative definitions are now attached to def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models and def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-roof in Sheaf.Paper.DerivedInternalHomFilteredColimitData; comparison_existsUnique is attached to lem-sfb-internal-hom-comparison-exists. The original module publicly reexports that data module, preserving existing consumers.
